messages:
alex_support: FYI customer #C-924 reports billing doubled after trying to void a charge. Our logs show the autorouter invoked apply_adjustment instead of void_charge. Payload and logs below.

maria_eng: can you paste the raw request they sent?

alex_support: here it is: ```{
  "intent": "void_charge",
  "amount": 12000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "charge_id": "ch_3Jk9X4"
}```

alex_support: server log snippet: ```2026-06-12T14:02:11Z autorouter INFO selected_tool=apply_adjustment confidence=0.63 reason=signature_match amount_field_type=integer```

jamal_sre: looks like the selector matched on the presence of amount + charge_id pattern. apply_adjustment signature allows amount + entity_id so fuzzy matcher picked it.

maria_eng: repro steps? can we hit the internal autorouter debug endpoint to see scoring? @devbot any existing trace?

devbot: trace created: trace_id=tr_9a7bcb, route_scores={apply_adjustment:0.63,void_charge:0.57} fallback_policy=none

lee_support: customer claims they only clicked "Void" in our dashboard — UI sends the same payload we pasted. Seems risky that small signature diff flips tool.

sophie_prod: this is a high-sev for finance. Can we add a guard that prevents apply_adjustment from firing when charge_id is present unless explicit override flag present?

maria_eng: quick mitigation: bump void_charge priority in the descriptor map for payloads containing charge_id pattern, and tighten apply_adjustment schema to require reason_code string. I'll push a hotfix to the autorouter rules.

jamal_sre: also recommend adding an alert when selected_tool != user_intent (if user_intent passed). That would catch these in the future.

alex_support: test plan: 1) deploy rule tweak to staging 2) run synthetic payloads with permutations of amount/charge_id/transaction_ref 3) validate route_scores favor void_charge 4) rollback if false positives.

maria_eng: on it — creating prow job and adding unit tests for fuzzy matching edgecases. ETA 2-3 hours for staged rollout.

lee_support: updated customer: we've prioritized a fix and will keep them posted. Thanks all. :pray:
